Deployment Guide

Introduction

This guide explains the basic steps required to run the User Access Control application in a local or server environment.

Prerequisites

Make sure the following software is installed:

  • Python 3.13

  • MySQL Server

  • Required Python packages

  • A compatible operating system

Project Configuration

  1. Download or clone the project repository.

  2. Open the project directory.

  3. Configure the database connection.

  4. Set the required environment variables.

  5. Install the Python dependencies.

Database Setup

  1. Start the MySQL server.

  2. Create the required database.

  3. Create the required database tables.

  4. Configure database credentials.

  5. Initialize the application data if required.

Run the Application Locally

Open the terminal in the project directory and execute:

python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload

The application will be available at:

http://127.0.0.1:8000

Production Deployment

For production deployment, consider the following practices:

  • Use HTTPS.

  • Store secrets in environment variables.

  • Disable development reload mode.

  • Use a production ASGI server configuration.

  • Configure secure session cookies.

  • Restrict database access.

  • Configure application logging.

  • Back up the database regularly.

  • Monitor application errors and availability.

Security Recommendations

  • Never commit passwords or secret keys to Git.

  • Use strong session secret keys.

  • Keep dependencies updated.

  • Use secure database credentials.

  • Apply appropriate access permissions.

Conclusion

Following these steps helps prepare the User Access Control application for deployment in a suitable environment.
